isComplaint.instructions: Is this post a complaint about the organizers?

criteria.true: The writer describes a problem, dissatisfaction, or a request for improvement. Includes indirect wording and sarcasm
criteria.false: A question, thanks, a report, an ad, or anything else that is not a complaint

department.instructions: Which team should handle this post?

criteria.honbu: Main office. Overall schedule, volunteers, trash, toilets, thanks and general feedback
criteria.yatai: Food stalls. Which stalls are open, prices, food
criteria.kotsu: Traffic and parking. Cars, bicycles, roads, buses
criteria.otoshimono: Lost and found. Things lost or found, runaway pets
criteria.kyugo: First aid and safety. Injuries, feeling unwell, lost children, danger
criteria.sonota: None of the above. Ads or anything unrelated to the festival

urgency.instructions: How urgently should the organizers respond to this post?
criteria: Not urgent. A later follow-up or a reply when someone is free is fine
Should be handled today. Someone is stuck right now, or it will get worse if left alone
Needs action right now. Someone's safety or health is involved

legend.0: Not urgent. A later follow-up or a reply when someone is free is fine
legend.1: Should be handled today. Someone is stuck right now, or it will get worse if left alone
legend.2: Needs action right now. Someone's safety or health is involved
